messages.subject: incompatibility between facet_wrap and coord_equal
parts:
Let me be brief:

d1 = data.frame(x=runif(10,1,10),y=runif(10,1,100), foo="a")
d2 = data.frame(x=runif(10,1,10),y=runif(10,1,100), foo="b")
d = rbind(d1,d2)
qplot(x, y, data=d) + facet_grid(~foo)
qplot(x, y, data=d) + facet_wrap(~foo)
qplot(x, y, data=d) + facet_grid(~foo) + coord_equal() # grid is square
qplot(x, y, data=d) + facet_wrap(~foo) + coord_equal() # coord_equal
has no effect

Thanks in advance.

JiHO
